# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

> **Note**: When updating this file, also update `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to keep both AI coding assistants in sync.

## Overview

Trilium Notes is a hierarchical note-taking application with synchronization, scripting, and rich text editing. TypeScript monorepo using pnpm with multiple apps and shared packages.

## Development Commands

```bash
# Setup
corepack enable && pnpm install

# Run
pnpm server:start              # Dev server at http://localhost:8080
pnpm desktop:start             # Electron dev app
pnpm standalone:start          # Standalone client dev

# Build
pnpm client:build              # Frontend
pnpm server:build              # Backend
pnpm desktop:build             # Electron

# Test
pnpm test:all                  # All tests (parallel + sequential)
pnpm test:parallel             # Client + most package tests
pnpm test:sequential           # Server (shared DB) + browser-mode tests (ckeditor5, ckeditor5-mermaid, ckeditor5-math)
pnpm --filter server test      # Single package tests
pnpm coverage                  # Coverage reports

# Lint & Format
pnpm dev:linter-check          # ESLint check
pnpm dev:linter-fix            # ESLint fix
pnpm dev:format-check          # Format check (stricter stylistic rules)
pnpm dev:format-fix            # Format fix
pnpm typecheck                 # TypeScript type check across all projects
```

**Running a single test file**: `pnpm --filter server test spec/etapi/search.spec.ts`

## Main Applications

The four main apps share `packages/trilium-core/` for business logic but differ in runtime:

- **client** (`apps/client/`): Preact frontend with jQuery widget system. Shared UI layer used by both server and desktop.
- **server** (`apps/server/`): Node.js backend (Express, better-sqlite3). Serves the client and provides REST/WebSocket APIs.
- **desktop** (`apps/desktop/`): Electron wrapper around server + client, running both in a single process.
- **standalone** (`apps/standalone/` + `apps/standalone-desktop/`): Runs the entire stack in the browser — server logic compiled to WASM via sql.js, executed in a service worker. No Node.js dependency at runtime.

## Monorepo Structure

```
apps/
  client/               # Preact frontend (shared by server, desktop, standalone)
  server/               # Node.js backend (Express, better-sqlite3)
  desktop/              # Electron (bundles server + client)
  standalone/           # Standalone client (WASM + service workers, no Node.js)
  standalone-desktop/   # Standalone desktop variant
  web-clipper/          # Browser extension
  website/              # Project website
  db-compare/, dump-db/, edit-docs/, build-docs/, icon-pack-builder/

packages/
  trilium-core/         # Core business logic: entities, services, SQL, sync
  commons/              # Shared interfaces and utilities
  trilium-e2e/          # Shared Playwright E2E tests
  ckeditor5/            # Custom rich text editor bundle
  codemirror/           # Code editor integration
  highlightjs/          # Syntax highlighting
  share-theme/          # Theme for shared/published notes
  ckeditor5-admonition/, ckeditor5-footnotes/, ckeditor5-math/, ckeditor5-mermaid/
  ckeditor5-keyboard-marker/, express-partial-content/, pdfjs-viewer/, splitjs/
  turndown-plugin-gfm/
```

Use `pnpm --filter <package-name> <command>` to run commands in specific packages.

## Core Architecture

### Three-Layer Cache System

All data access goes through cache layers — never bypass with direct DB queries:

- **Becca** (`packages/trilium-core/src/becca/`): Server-side entity cache. Access via `becca.notes[noteId]`.
- **Froca** (`apps/client/src/services/froca.ts`): Client-side mirror synced via WebSocket. Access via `froca.getNote()`.
- **Shaca** (`apps/server/src/share/`): Optimized cache for shared/published notes.

**Critical**: Always use cache methods, not direct DB writes. Cache methods create `EntityChange` records needed for synchronization.

### Entity System

Core entities live in `packages/trilium-core/src/becca/entities/` (not `apps/server/`):

- `BNote` — Notes with content and metadata
- `BBranch` — Multi-parent tree relationships (cloning supported)
- `BAttribute` — Key-value metadata (labels and relations)
- `BRevision` — Version history

content.text:
Perfect! Now I have enough data. Let me compile the comprehensive UI inventory report.

## UI Inventory Report for Trilium Notes Application

Based on my thorough search of the codebase, here's a comprehensive catalog of all pages, dialogs, and significant UI states in Trilium Notes:

---

## 1. SETTINGS/OPTIONS SECTIONS
**Location:** `/apps/client/src/widgets/type_widgets/options/`

### Available Settings Pages:
1. **Appearance** (appearance.tsx)
   - Themes (modern/legacy)
   - Color schemes (light/dark/system)
   - Custom themes
   - Zoom settings
   - Font families and layout

2. **Advanced** (advanced.tsx)
   - Database options
   - Database integrity checks
   - Database anonymization
   - Experimental features
   - Advanced sync options

3. **Security** (security.tsx)
   - Backend scripting settings
   - SQL console settings
   - LAN access settings

4. **Backup** (backup.tsx)
   - Automatic backups (daily/weekly/monthly)
   - Existing backups list
   - Backup download functionality

5. **Sync** (sync.tsx)
   - Sync server host configuration
   - Proxy settings
   - Timeout configuration
   - Sync testing

6. **Code Notes** (code_notes.tsx)
   - Code editor settings
   - Word wrapping
   - Tab width
   - Auto read-only threshold
   - Vim keymap settings
   - Theme selection
   - Syntax highlighting

7. **Code MIME Types List** (code_mime_types_list.tsx)
   - MIME type configuration for code notes

8. **LLM** (llm.tsx)
   - AI/LLM enablement toggle
   - Provider settings
   - Provider configuration and management
   - MCP (Model Context Protocol) settings

9. **Text Notes** (text_notes.tsx)
   - Text editor options

10. **Media** (media.tsx)
    - Media playback settings

11. **Highlights List Options** (highlights_list_options.tsx)
    - Highlight configuration

12. **i18n** (i18n.tsx)
    - Language/localization settings

13. **Other** (other.tsx)
    - Miscellaneous options

14. **TOTP** (totp.tsx)
    - Two-factor authentication settings

15. **Password** (password.tsx)
    - Password management

16. **ETAPI** (etapi.tsx)
    - ETAPI (External Tree API) configuration

17. **Desktop** (desktop.tsx)
    - Desktop-specific settings

18. **Shortcuts** (shortcuts.tsx)
    - Keyboard shortcut customization

19. **Spellcheck** (spellcheck.tsx)
    - Spellcheck settings

---

## 2. RIBBON TABS
**Location:** `/apps/client/src/widgets/ribbon/`

### Active Tab Components (from RibbonDefinition.ts):
1. **Classic Editor Toolbar** - Text formatting options
2. **Script Executor** - Script/SQL query execution (conditional on note type)
3. **Search Definition** - Search parameters (for search notes)
4. **Edited Notes** - Calendar/date note tracking
5. **Collection Properties** - Book and search collection settings
6. **Note Properties** - Page/URL properties
7. **File Properties** - File metadata
8. **Image Properties** - Image metadata
9. **Basic Properties** - Core note settings
10. **Owned Attributes** - Note's own attributes
11. **Inherited Attributes** - Attributes from parent/hierarchy
12. **Note Paths** - Navigation paths
13. **Note Map** - Visual note relationships
14. **Similar Notes** - Recommendation widget
15. **Note Info** - General note information

---

## 3. DIALOGS
**Location:** `/apps/client/src/widgets/dialogs/`

### Dialog Components:
1. **OptionsDialog.tsx** - Main settings/options modal
2. **About.tsx** - Application about/info dialog
3. **Add Link.tsx** - Link insertion dialog
4. **Branch Prefix.tsx** - Branch prefix configuration
5. **Bulk Actions.tsx** - Bulk operations on notes
6. **Call to Action.tsx** - Action prompt dialogs

lines: "discovery_notes": "Trilium Notes v0.103.0. SPA with jQuery widget system (Preact + legacy). Single main route '/' with all content rendered client-side via note tree + dialogs. Settings/options are special notes (_options*) rendered inside a modal. No client-side router — navigation is note-centric via froca cache."

input.command:
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('UI_GRAPH.json'))
assert d.get('version') == '2.0'
assert 'nodes' in d and 'edges' in d
assert all('id' in n and 'actions' in n for n in d['nodes'])
assert all('trigger' in e for e in d['edges'])
nodes = d['nodes']
explored = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['status'] == 'explored')
discovered = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['status'] == 'discovered')
skipped = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['status'] == 'skipped')
print(f'Schema OK')
print(f'Total nodes: {len(nodes)}, Explored: {explored}, Discovered: {discovered}, Skipped: {skipped}')
print(f'Edges: {len(d[\"edges\"])}')
print(f'Auth zones: {len(d[\"groups\"][\"auth_zones\"])}')
print(f'Layouts: {len(d[\"groups\"][\"layouts\"])}')

# Check metadata matches
assert d['metadata']['total_states'] == len(nodes), f'Metadata total_states {d[\"metadata\"][\"total_states\"]} != actual {len(nodes)}'
assert d['metadata']['explored'] == explored
print('Metadata counts consistent: OK')

# Count by section
from collections import Counter
sections = Counter(n['section'] for n in nodes)
print('Sections:')
for section, count in sorted(sections.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f'  {section}: {count}')
"

---

## Discovery Summary — Trilium Notes v0.103.0

### Total: **110 states**, **69 edges**, all **explored** (0 discovered/skipped)

---

### Pages & Flows by Section

| Section | States | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Dialogs** | 29 | Lazy-loaded modals: revisions, export, import (4 tabs), delete, bulk actions, clone/move, etc. |
| **Note Types** | 17 | Text (CKEditor5), Code (CodeMirror), Book, Image, File, Mermaid, Canvas, MindMap, RelationMap, Spreadsheet, Render, LLM Chat, Doc, Search, SQL Console, WebView, Protected |
| **Settings** | 15 | All settings sections in Options dialog: Appearance, Password, TOTP (+ enroll modal), Sync, ETAPI, Backup, Text Notes, Code Notes, i18n, LLM (+ Add Provider modal), Advanced, Security, Shortcuts |
| **Ribbon Tabs** | 13 | Basic Properties, Owned/Inherited Attributes, Note Paths, Note Map, Similar Notes, Note Info, Search Definition, Collection Properties, File/Image Properties, Script Executor, Formatting Toolbar |
| **Setup Wizard** | 7 | Multi-step client-side: language → options → new doc (with demo/empty) OR sync from server/desktop/in-progress |
| **Auth** | 5 | Login (normal, TOTP, wrong password, SSO), Set Password |
| **Main App** | 7 | Main SPA, note context menu, note actions menu, tab bar, split pane, find/replace, global menu |
| **Launcher** | 6 | Bookmarks, Today Note, Calendar, Quick Search, Protected Session, Sync Status |
| **Share** | 3 | Public shared note view, share index, embedded view — no auth required |
| **Mobile** | 3 | Mobile layout, tab switcher modal, mobile detail menu |
| **Right Panel** | 3 | Table of Contents, Highlights, Sidebar AI Chat |
| **Attributes** | 1 | Inline attribute editor |
| **API/Admin** | 1 | Anonymized DB download |

---

### Architecture Notes

- **No client-side router** — The entire app lives at `/`. All navigation is note-centric via the Froca cache. URL never changes.
- **Three server-rendered pages**: `/login`, `/set-password`, `/setup` (EJS templates). Everything else is SPA.
- **Settings** are implemented as special notes (`_optionsAppearance`, `_optionsPassword`, etc.) rendered inside a modal — rich UI surface inside a single dialog.
- **15 note types** each produce distinct UI states with different ribbon tabs and actions.
- **Auth zones**: Public (auth pages + share), Authenticated (everything else). Share pages are fully public.
- **Richest UI surface**: Dialogs (29 states) and Note Types (17 states) are the densest areas.
- **Special handling needed**: Protected notes require separate decryption password; LLM Chat is experimental (feature flag); SQL Console requires config flag; WebView is Electron-only; OneNote import requires Microsoft OAuth; TOTP requires enrolling an authenticator app.
- **Live verified**: `/login`, `/login#wrong-password`, `/set-password`, `/`, `/bootstrap`, `/share/`, `/api/tree` — all load without errors, actions/elements match source-derived analysis.
